audit_type: public-source ordered sequence reconstruction consistency check
sorting_rule: Flatten Techniques[].Steps[]; parse SubStep into numeric major step, branch letter, and numeric suborder; sort lexicographically by (major step, branch letter, numeric suborder).
interpretation: This supports consistency of the ordered (SubStep, TechniqueId) reconstruction across five public vendor result files. These files represent the same MITRE-designed APT29 emulation flow, not five independent campaigns. The check does not validate model forecasts, the clustering ranking policy, synthetic data counts, or reported top-k scores.
immutable_revision_check: See audit/pinned_source_revision_audit.json for per-file Git blob SHA-1 IDs fetched at this commit. Git blob SHA-1 IDs are not SHA-256 raw-file hashes.
